abstract: We conducted a double-blind randomized controlled trial in 124 adults (aged 18-65) with chronic insomnia. Participants received NX-3 or placebo for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep latency measured by polysomnography. NX-3 significantly reduced sleep latency compared with placebo.
title: Synthetic peptide NX-3 versus placebo for sleep latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

abstract: This randomized placebo-controlled trial enrolled 88 children aged 6-12 years with insomnia. Participants received NX-3 or placebo for 6 weeks. Sleep latency was assessed by actigraphy. The study population was exclusively pediatric.
title: NX-3 for pediatric insomnia: a randomized placebo-controlled trial in children aged 6-12

abstract: In this pilot randomized placebo-controlled study, 40 adults with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo. Sleep latency was the primary endpoint. The trial was conducted in 2011 and published in 2012.
title: NX-3 in chronic insomnia: a randomized placebo-controlled pilot study

abstract: We randomized 150 participants aged 16 to 65 years with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or placebo. Sleep latency was measured by sleep diaries and actigraphy over 8 weeks.
title: NX-3 versus placebo in patients aged 16 to 65 with chronic insomnia: a randomized trial

abstract: This multicenter randomized controlled trial randomly assigned 240 adults with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or matching placebo for 6 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep onset latency measured by polysomnography. NX-3 shortened sleep onset latency versus placebo.
title: NX-3 versus placebo on sleep onset latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a multicenter randomized controlled trial

abstract: In a randomized controlled trial, 96 older adults (aged 60-80) with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo. Sleep latency was assessed by polysomnography at baseline and week 4. NX-3 improved sleep latency relative to placebo.
title: Effects of NX-3 versus placebo on sleep latency in older adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

abstract: Adults with chronic insomnia were randomly assigned to NX-3 or zolpidem; no placebo arm was included. Sleep latency was measured by polysomnography. Both treatments reduced sleep latency, with no significant difference between arms.
title: NX-3 versus zolpidem in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized head-to-head trial.

abstract: Sixty adults with chronic insomnia were allocated to NX-3 or placebo by alternation. Sleep latency was recorded with sleep diaries over 4 weeks. Allocation was not concealed.
title: NX-3 versus placebo for chronic insomnia: a quasi-randomized trial.

abstract: We enrolled 132 adults with chronic insomnia and baseline sleep latency over 30 minutes in a randomized controlled trial of NX-3 versus placebo. The primary endpoint was sleep latency measured by polysomnography at week 6.
title: NX-3 versus placebo in adults with chronic insomnia and prolonged sleep latency: a randomized controlled trial.

abstract: This narrative review summarizes the pharmacology of the synthetic peptide NX-3 and discusses published trials in insomnia. No original data are presented.
title: Synthetic peptide NX-3 for insomnia: a narrative review of mechanisms and trials

abstract: In this randomized controlled trial, 140 adults with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo for 8 weeks. The primary outcome was the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index. Sleep onset latency was recorded as an exploratory secondary outcome using actigraphy.
title: NX-3 versus placebo and sleep quality in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

abstract: In this randomized controlled trial, 110 adults with chronic insomnia took NX-3 or placebo at bedtime for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep latency measured by polysomnography.
title: Bedtime administration of NX-3 versus placebo and sleep latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial
